items.title: Getting to know each other
items.note: Names, strengths, curiosities, what each person wants from the weekend.

items.title: Self-study
items.note: Individual exploration. Return with propositions, questions, evidence, or surprising directions — not finished solutions.

items.title: Stand-up · idea discussion
items.note: Share propositions, collide ideas, surface disagreements, choose what to test next.

items.title: Open creation block I
items.note: Frame the problem, inspect data, run cheap tests. Avoid premature parallel implementation.

items.title: Lunch + informal synthesis
items.note: Keep it light. Capture only decisions that actually matter.

items.title: Open creation block II
items.note: Prototype the smallest end-to-end interaction that tests the core claim.

items.title: Checkpoint · what changed our mind?
items.note: Review evidence, rejected ideas, current risks, and whether the concept still deserves investment.

items.title: Open creation block III
items.note: Build, integrate, test. Keep the demo path continuously runnable.

items.title: Saturday close
items.note: Record current state, open loops, ownership and the first move for Sunday.

items.title: Finish the proof
items.note: Close only the gaps that matter for the core story and demo.

items.title: Demo + narrative rehearsal
items.note: Run the actual demo. Remove fragile steps. Make evidence and limitations visible.

items.title: Travel / setup buffer
items.note: Get to the convergence venue with enough margin.

items.title: Doors open · find a table and set up
Last hour · finish, polish, demo running

external_context.label: Thursday Evening · Discovery
external_context.detail: Challenges revealed online. Browse, think, imagine possibilities. No pressure to decide yet.

external_context.label: Friday Evening · Connection
external_context.detail: Meetup at Manabar, Güterstrasse 99, 4053 Basel. Meet participants, discover challenges in person, start forming teams.
